english_title: Who Is On The Lord’s Side

stanzas.shona_lyrics:
Ndiani muKristu?
Abatire Ishe?
Ndiani anoda
Kuwana vamwe?
Ndiani wosiya
Zvinhu zvenyika?
Ndiani muKritsu,
Anomurwira?

Nom’towo waIshe,
Nomutsa wake,
Tiri vashandiri
VaKristu Ishe.
Hatide kukudzwa,
Kana nokugadzwa;
Asi, tasarudza
Nzira yokurwa,
Nom’towo wokuda,
Vaakafira,
Waanodaidza,
Anomurwira.

Jesu matitenga
Pasina ndarama;
Asi ropa renyu
Ratinunura.
Gomborero renyu
Rotizadzisa,
Nemi tinobvuma
Tasunungurwa.

Kurwa naSatani
Ndiko kukukutu;
Asi ichakunda
Hondo yaKristu.
Pasi pomureza
Tiri kurwira,
Neizwi raJesu
Tinozokunda.

Tenzi, tichengetei
Nendoni dzenyu,
Kuti tigorwira
‘She, tiri venyu.

author: N/A

english_title: I’ll Go In The Strength Of The Lord
tune_source: Thou Shepherd of Israel, 487; In the strength of the Lord, 485

stanzas.shona_lyrics:
Ndoenda nesimba raShe,
Munzira dzaagadzira;
Ndotevera shoko rake,
Handitye kunyange njodzi,
Kwari ini ndoenda,
Iye achapa zvose,
Kusvika rwendo rwapera
Ndichagarovimba naye.

Ndoenda, ndoenda, ndoenda nesimba
Ndoenda nesimba raShe,
Ndoenda, ndoenda, ndoenda nesimba
Ndoenda nesimba raShe.

Ndoenda nesimba raShe,
Kubasa raanondipa;
Rufaro rwaanondipa
Rwondimutsurura mweya;
Iye wondidzivirira,
Nesimba wondichengeta,
Ndovimba nesimba rake,
Ndoga rurudo rwake.

Ndoenda nesimba raShe,
Norutendo muzviedzo,
Ngoni dzake dzova nhowo.
Kutsunga kwokurudzira,
Sezvo achitungamira,
Mukusangana nemhandu,
Nebakatwa rechokwadi,
Mukutambura ndokunda.

author: Edward Turney (1816-72)
